rv.q: "My Brother Langston" does an adequate job of introducing major themes of Hughes’ writings and the overall arc of his early life and career, but the production truly shines when the spotlight is on Hughes’ own words.
His wonderful writing, direction, choreography and costumes make this production a winner.
My Brother Langston is deeply satisfying on many levels.
My Brother Langston is exciting and engaging, making you want to learn more about the character.
This is a very good play and I have no doubt that audiences will enjoy it.
While 'My Brother Langston' succeeds as a great introduction to the life and times of Langston Hughes, it will likely leave members of the audience wanting more.
This production sees Rueben take BET to a new level of accomplishment and I don’t say this lightly.
My Brother Langston is a witty, informative, and well-put-together production. I highly recommend this production to those, especially the Harlem Renaissance era fans.

cn.t: Critics praise this heartfelt tribute to Langston Hughes, celebrating the poet's powerful words through compelling performances and music. The Black Ensemble Theater production earns acclaim for its emotional resonance and effective channeling of Hughes's genius.
